title: Apple Q4 2026: revenue up 12% to $114.5 billion, a record year
h1: Apple's revenue rose 12% to $114.5 billion last quarter, closing its biggest year ever, with tariff refunds adding to the margin
description: Apple reported fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $114.5 billion on November 2, up 12%, and record yearly sales of $479 billion. iPhone, Mac and guidance details.
standfirst: iPhone and Mac drove the September quarter, while iPad and wearables shrank. Apple said refunds of tariffs it had paid added about a point to its gross margin.
keywords: Apple Q4 2026 earnings, Apple fiscal 2026 revenue, iPhone revenue September quarter, Apple tariff refunds margin, Apple December quarter guidance
takeaways: Fiscal Q4 revenue was $114.5 billion, up 12%, and earnings per share were $2.10, up 14%.
Full-year fiscal 2026 revenue was about $479 billion, Apple's highest ever.
Apple guided to December-quarter revenue growth of 7% to 10%.
body: Apple reported revenue of $114.5 billion for its fiscal fourth quarter, which ended September 26, up 12% from a year earlier, in results released on November 2. Diluted earnings per share were $2.10, up 14%. Full-year revenue reached about $479 billion, which chief executive John Ternus described as "capping off our best fiscal year ever."

iPhone revenue rose 17% to $57.6 billion and Mac revenue jumped 24% to $10.8 billion, according to MacRumors' breakdown of Apple's figures. Services set a record at $31.6 billion, up 10%. iPad revenue fell 10% to $6.2 billion, and wearables, home and accessories fell 8% to $8.3 billion. Net income was $30.7 billion.

Apple said its 47.9% gross margin included about one percentage point from tariff refunds, and that refunds added $0.05 to earnings per share. Importers have been seeking refunds of duties collected under the emergency tariff program; our guide to IEEPA tariff refunds explains how that process works for smaller companies. Apple generated $28 billion in operating cash flow and returned $28 billion to shareholders. Its board declared a dividend of $0.27 a share, payable November 16 to holders of record on November 12.

For the December quarter, Apple expects revenue to grow 7% to 10% and gross margin of 45% to 46%, MacRumors reported from the earnings call. Results beat analysts' estimates of $113.47 billion in revenue and $2.00 a share, but the shares slipped about 1% after hours as investors focused on slowing growth, TheStreet reported.

faq.q: How much revenue did Apple make in fiscal 2026?
faq.a: About $479 billion, the highest in Apple's history, according to its November 2, 2026 results.

faq.a: Apple declared $0.27 a share, payable November 16, 2026 to shareholders of record on November 12.
